declare @$tracked bit, @$location bit, @$lot bit

if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_instock_split' and val = '1') begin
  if @@id <> '' and object_id('dmctvtrlo') is not null begin
    exec sp_executesql N'select @location = vi_tri_yn, @lot = lo_yn from dmctvtrlo where ma_ct = '@@id'', N'@location bit output, @lot bit output', @location = @$location output, @lot = @$lot output

  if @$lot is null select @$lot = cast(rtrim(val) as bit) from options where name = 'm_kt_td_lo_yn'
end else select @$location = 1, @$lot = 1, @$tracked = 0

select @message = @message + 'this._tracked = ' + rtrim(@$tracked) + ';this._tracked$Location = ' + rtrim(@$location) + ';this._tracked$Lot = ' + rtrim(@$lot) + ';'

if @$location = 0 select @message = @message + 'this._fields[this._getColumnOrder(''ma_vi_tri'') - 1].Visible = false;'

]]>

<![CDATA[
function insert$Retrieve$Items(g, r1, z, r2, columns, c1, c2) {
  var a1 = (columns + (c1 ? ',' + c1 : '')).split(','), a2 = (columns + (c2 ? ',' + c2 : '')).split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a1.length; i++) {
    var l1 = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a1[i])), l2 = z._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a2[i]));
    if (l1 > 0 && l2 > 0) z._setItemValue(r2, l2, g._getItemValue(r1, l1));
  }
}
]]>

Name: ScriptEmptyExternalField
Content:
<![CDATA[
function set$Voucher$EmptyExternalField(g, s) {
  var a = s.split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    var l = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a[i]));
    for (var r = 0; r < g._rowCount; r++) {
      g._setItemValue(r + 1, l, null);
    }
  }
}
]]>

declare @ownerID int, @isChange bit
select @ownerID = isnull(user_id0, 0) from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
select @isChange = 0
select @script = @script + 'refresh$APV$Status(this,''' + @$status + ''', ''' + @$u_status + ''',''' + @$userName3 + ''',''' + @kieu_duyet + ''')'
if(@$status in ('', '', '')) begin
  create table #mail(id int, stt_rec char(13), userID int, xtype int)
  if @$status = '' set @ownerID = 0
  if (@$u_status0 = '' or @$u_status0 = '0' or @$status = '' or (@$u_status0 = '1' and $.NewValue <> $.OldValue)) set @isChange = 1
  if not exists(select 1 from sodmquyenct where loai_duyet = '' and ma_quyen = @role and status = '' and created_mail_yn = '1' and kieu_duyet = @kieu_duyet) select @ownerID = 0
  insert into #mail exec FastBusiness$APV$SO$GetApprovalMailList @stt_rec, '$partition$current', '', '@@sysDatabaseName', 0, @isChange, @ownerID
  declare @p int, @mailUser int, @xtype int
  select @p = min(id) from #mail
  while @p is not null begin
    select @mailUser = userID, @xtype = xtype from #mail where id = @p
    select @invoke = @invoke + case when @invoke = '' then '' else '&' + char(255) + ';' end + 'Message.Message.SendPrivate(' + '' + ',' + @stt_rec + ',' + '@@appDatabaseName' + char(255) + '@@sysDatabaseName' + ',1,' + rtrim(@mailUser)+ ',' + rtrim(@xtype) + ')' 
    select @p = min(id) from #mail where id > @p
  end
  
end else begin
  if @$status = '0' delete dmxn where stt_rec = @stt_rec
end

  end
